newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 21.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 22 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- If we return to monetary emission now, it will destroy everything we have managed to achieve so far, says Sergei Dubinin, the head of Russia's Central Bank, referring to a communist proposal to boost the money supply.
- The State Duma lower house of parliament, which is against the government spending cuts plan, wants the country to continue overspending.
- New regional bonds are likely to start circulating on the Russian stock market in June.
- An uncertain situation with the mineral resources production sharing law causes only debates and does not bring positive results for the Russian economy.
- Inefficiency of economic reforms in Russia hampers accumulation of national capital.
